dc:title: Meggitt-Wagner Classification of Diabetic Foot Lesions Knowledge Object
dc:description: This demonstration-only CKS classifies one diabetic foot lesion or assessment site, at one assessment event, as Wagner score 0-5. It specifies classification—not treatment, prognosis, amputation risk, or hyperbaric-oxygen eligibility.

schema:creator.schema:name: Knowledge Systems Lab
schema:creator.schema:affiliation: Knowledge Systems Lab, University of Michigan Medical School

koio:hasKnowledge.dc:title: Wagner Questionnaire Logic
koio:hasKnowledge.dc:description: Ten yes or no questions, with adaptive logic, to classify a diabetic foot lesion as Wagner score 0-5.
koio:hasKnowledge.dc:purpose: Guides the end user through required adaptive Yes/No data collection and prevents an unworkable response set.

koio:hasTest.dc:title: Wagner Questionnaire Test
koio:hasTest.dc:description: Node.js test suite that exercises multiple decision paths of the Wagner questionnaire runner and verifies the returned response vector, directly answered versus entailed questions, and definition metadata in question payloads.

koio:hasKnowledge.dc:title: Wagner Questionnaire Scorer
koio:hasKnowledge.dc:purpose: Validates and analyzes any received response set, whether or not it came from the protected questionnaire interface.

koio:hasTest.dc:title: Wagner Questionnaire Scorer Test
koio:hasTest.dc:description: Node.js test suite for the Wagner scorer that verifies output shape, grade computation across representative questionnaire paths, and handling of indeterminate, incomplete, invalid, and conflicting response patterns.

koio:hasService.dc:description: command-line program that interactively asks the Wagner questionnaire yes/no questions (with related term definitions), then prints both the questionnaire outcome and its computed analysis as formatted JSON.
